text: The defendants harmed by section 7216 would almost all be non-US financial intermediaries and issuers who are less able to defend themselves in the US political system, which helps explain why Congress is not seriously considering repeal of the PSLRA but is seriously considering section 7216.
citation: Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Extraterritorial Application of US Securities Law – Will the US Become the Default Jurisdiction for (2010). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1664809
